title: What do you do when your market data API goes down?
author: Global_Bottle3744
selftext:
I’ve been thinking about switching between different market data APIs in a trading system. It sounds simple, but data from different providers rarely matches perfectly—timestamps, adjusted prices, missing candles, and so on.

If your primary API goes down, do you stop trading or switch to a backup API and deal with the differences?

comments.author: TheAlxOf96
comments.body: If this happens more often I would switch instantly my data provider tbh :D

comments.author: fomoz
comments.body: Use the API from your broker. If it's down, you should find another broker and never use that broker again.
